chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Maysarah, from Abī ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام: the like of it.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: title referring to Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: meaning: the same as the previous report or wording
key_terms.وَلَغَ: lapped or drank with the tongue, especially said of a dog

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on water when a dog has lapped in it according to a narration in al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This report consists of a sanad ending with Abī ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام and concludes with the phrase "the like of it," indicating that the matn is the same as a preceding narration. In context, it pertains to the legal ruling concerning water into which a dog has lapped.
